steps.sql: with b as (select (now() at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok')::date d), x as (select d, d - 1 as y, (date_trunc('month', d) - interval '1 month')::date as pf, (date_trunc('month', d)::date - 1) as pt, (date_trunc('month', d) + interval '1 month')::date as nf, (date_trunc('month', d) + interval '2 month')::date - 1 as nt from b) select to_char(d, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as today, to_char(d, 'DD/MM/') || (extract(year from d)::int + 543) as today_th, to_char(y, 'DD/MM/') || (extract(year from y)::int + 543) as yday_th, to_char(pf, 'DD/MM/') || (extract(year from pf)::int + 543) as pm_from_th, to_char(pt, 'DD/MM/') || (extract(year from pt)::int + 543) as pm_to_th, to_char(nf, 'DD/MM/') || (extract(year from nf)::int + 543) as nm_from_th, to_char(nt, 'DD/MM/') || (extract(year from nt)::int + 543) as nm_to_th, to_char(y, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as yday from x

steps.sql: select m.code as party from ap_supplier m where m.code not like 'UAT%' and m.code ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9._/-]+$' and not exists (select 1 from ic_trans x where x.cust_code = m.code) and not exists (select 1 from ap_ar_trans y where y.cust_code = m.code) order by md5(m.code || :'rs') limit 1

steps.title: เลือกสินค้า/คลัง/ราคา/อัตราภาษี/รูปแบบเลขเอกสารจากใบซื้อเชื่อจริงล่าสุด
steps.sql: select coalesce(nullif(t.doc_format_code, ''), 'PU') as fmt, d.item_code as item, d.unit_code as unit, d.wh_code as wh, d.shelf_code as shelf, d.stand_value::text as stand, d.divide_value::text as divide, d.price::text as price, t.vat_rate::text as vat_rate, coalesce((select p.doc_format_code from ap_ar_trans p where p.trans_flag = 19 and p.doc_no not like 'UAT%' and coalesce(p.doc_format_code, '') <> '' order by p.doc_date desc limit 1), 'DE') as pay_fmt from ic_trans t join ic_trans_detail d on d.doc_no = t.doc_no and d.trans_flag = t.trans_flag join ic_inventory i on i.code = d.item_code where t.trans_flag = 12 and t.inquiry_type = 0 and t.vat_type = 0 and t.vat_rate > 0 and t.doc_no not like 'UAT%' and coalesce(t.is_cancel, 0) = 0 and t.last_status = 0 and d.price > 0 and d.price = round(d.price, 2) and d.tax_type = 0 and d.stand_value > 0 and d.divide_value > 0 order by t.doc_date desc, t.roworder desc limit 1

steps.title: คำนวณยอดที่คาด: บิล = 2 × ราคา + ภาษี, ชำระ = มูลค่าก่อนภาษี, คงค้าง = ภาษี
steps.sql: with c as (select round(2 * :'price'::numeric, 2) as b), v as (select b, round(b * :'vat_rate'::numeric / 100, 2) as vt from c) select b::text as base, (b + vt)::text as total, b::text as paid, vt::text as remain, (-b)::text as paid_neg, to_char(b + vt, 'FM999,999,999,990.00') as total_f, to_char(b, 'FM999,999,999,990.00') as paid_f from v
